instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects VXLAN tunnel traffic on UDP port 4789. If the VXLAN VNI matches 35957 and the inner packet is IPv4 targeting port 8443, drop the packet (XDP_DROP). Pass all other valid tunnel traffic and non-tunnel packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Parse outer Ethernet, IPv4, and UDP headers
Parse 8-byte VXLAN header and extract 24-bit VNI (target VNI: 35957)
Parse inner Ethernet and inner IPv4 headers
If inner protocol is TCP or UDP targeting port 8443 with VNI 35957, return XDP_DROP
Perform bounds checking at every encapsulation layer and return XDP_PASS on truncation
Entry point SEC("xdp") and GPL license

tests.name: match_vxlan_target_drop
tests.description: VXLAN VNI 35957 with inner port 8443 must be dropped

tests.name: non_match_inner_port_pass
tests.description: Different inner destination port must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_packet_pass
tests.description: Truncated packet boundary check must return XDP_PASS safely
